title: 摩根资管：市场调整后，AI与新能源板块迎来配置窗口？
speaker: Travis Spence

segments.en: So China has been quite a love part of the market, right?
segments.zh: 中国市场一直是市场的重要组成部分，对吧？

segments.en: How did you select the steam focusing on growth stocks?
segments.zh: 您是如何选择聚焦成长型权益资产的？

segments.en: And what other products do you have in the pipeline for China?
segments.zh: 针对中国市场，您还有哪些其他产品在筹备中？

segments.en: Yeah, I think one, I think growth is a really important dynamic in China.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为成长是中国市场非常重要的动力。

segments.en: So again, two speed economy, you've got property in some of the consumer sectors that are a little bit more sluggish.
segments.zh: 再次强调，经济呈现双速增长，地产和部分消费领域稍显疲软。

segments.en: But the AI, the hardware, the lithium batteries, construction equipment, those are all sectors that we like.
segments.zh: 但人工智能、硬件、锂电池、工程机械，这些都是我们看好的领域。

segments.en: I think in particular, given what's happened over the last four months or so, we've had this big drawdown in the markets.
segments.zh: 尤其是考虑到过去四个月左右市场出现了大幅回调。

segments.en: It's not so much driven by the fundamentals or company health.
segments.zh: 这并非由基本面或公司健康状况驱动。

segments.en: It's more the valuation story. So we actually see it as a great opportunity to start adding into these kinds of sectors at a reasonable valuation.
segments.zh: 更多是估值层面的变化。因此，我们认为这实际上是一个很好的机会，可以以合理的估值开始配置这类领域。

segments.en: And obviously, this is a long-term game. I think there's a lot of growth prospects across the AI stack in China going forward and
segments.zh: 显然，这是一场长期游戏。我认为未来中国人工智能产业链存在大量增长前景。

segments.en: the technology sector. So we see those as really attractive anyway.
segments.zh: 科技板块。所以我们认为这些板块非常有吸引力。

segments.en: I think that's a great reason for starting with the growth ETF.
segments.zh: 我认为这是从成长型ETF开始的一个很好的理由。

segments.en: You think that it could actually, in some ways, stabilize markets, just having active ETFs.
segments.zh: 你认为，拥有主动型ETF实际上可能在某些方面稳定市场。

segments.en: You mentioned how it's a good entry point to get into some of these growth stocks in particular.
segments.zh: 你提到这是进入一些成长型权益资产的好切入点。

segments.en: So timing, you think actually makes sense. Well, I think timing is what it is.
segments.zh: 所以你认为时机确实合理。嗯，我认为时机就是如此。

segments.en: But I think there's definitely opportunities that we see in those kind of sectors now.
segments.zh: 但我认为目前我们在这些板块中确实看到了机会。

segments.en: But I think overall, I think many investors, when they look at China, they want to see a growth story.
segments.zh: 但总体而言，我认为许多市场参与者在看中国时，希望看到增长故事。

segments.en: And many investors inside China want to see and take advantage of the growth story.
segments.zh: 而中国国内的许多市场参与者也希望看到并利用增长故事。

segments.en: So again, I think this is a great starting point for us.
segments.zh: 所以，我认为这对我们来说是一个很好的起点。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。
